question: What is the distance to a park from Rehfeld's Art & Framing, Sioux Falls, SD within 3700 meters, and what altitude does it have?
sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-96.726608 43.5456)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-96.726608 43.5456)',4326)::geography,
        3700
      )
  AND leisure = 'park';

poi.description: NJB - Mulzer - Batting Cages - Babe Ruth Field
